nodes.rationale: Described as the one piece of the tool the author would never want to regress silently — 17 isolated tests lock down the secret-redaction behavior.

nodes.label: vercel-guardian (README)
nodes.rationale: Built after a client's production deployment sat broken for two weeks because nobody was watching it — `vercel ls` doesn't reveal whether production is actually healthy, whether Web Analytics is configured, or whether an unrecognized deploy hook was added.

nodes.label: audit job
nodes.rationale: Only runs once VERCEL_TOKEN + VERCEL_SCOPE repo secrets/vars are set — forking this template gives CI + tests for free, and this job just sits idle (not failing) until the user configures their own Vercel account.

nodes.label: vercel login (local interactive alternative)
nodes.rationale: Local interactive use can skip VERCEL_TOKEN entirely and rely on `vercel login` instead — the token is only required for non-interactive CI runs.
